ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of white high-intensity pixels to black low-intensity pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central black pigmentation zone radiating from the median notch, bifurcating into both lobes. Right lobe features a white contiguous field with black pigmentation extending along the inner trailing edge and the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetric serration density; left lobe trailing edge displays low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-irregularities; right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, moderate-amplitude serrations (saw-tooth profile) transitioning to a more irregular border toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep trajectory leading to distal tips. Left lobe distal tip exhibits a pronounced inward-curving hook (falcate morphology). Right lobe distal tip exhibits a tapered upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 4-6 parallel, vertically oriented dark linear marks (rake-like disruptions) are visible on the white mid-section of the right lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged erosion on the trailing edge of the right lobe lobe compared to the left suggests physical wear or historic trauma. Distinctive hooked morphology of the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: An avian subject (white/gray pixel cluster) is detected in the upper-right background quadrant, isolated from the whale subject.
